title: Finite index constant mean curvature hypersurfaces in low dimensions
summary: We prove that every complete finite index immersed CMC hypersurface is either minimal or compact, provided that the ambient six-dimensional manifold is a Riemannian product of a closed manifold with non-negative sectional curvature and a Euclidean factor. This answers affirmatively a question posed by do Carmo, for this class of ambient spaces, and extends known lower dimensional results. As a consequence, we complete the classification of two-sided, complete weakly stable CMC hypersurfaces immersed in the space forms of positive curvature in dimension six.
